scripts.dev: concurrently -n "next,scrapling" -c "green,magenta" "next dev" "cd scrapling-agent && uv run uvicorn server:app --port 8001"
scripts.dev:scrapling: cd scrapling-agent && uv run uvicorn server:app --port 8001
scripts.test:crawler: vitest run src/lib/__tests__/crawlerCatalog.validation.test.ts src/lib/__tests__/crawlerDb.test.ts src/lib/__tests__/crawlerDedupScale.test.ts src/lib/__tests__/crawlerNormalizer.test.ts src/lib/__tests__/crawlerRanking.test.ts src/lib/__tests__/sourceTaxonomy.test.ts src/lib/__tests__/directAts.test.ts
scripts.sources:validate: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('scrapling-agent/sources.json','utf-8')); if(s.schemaVersion!==2||!Array.isArray(s.sources)) process.exit(1); console.log('✓ sources.json v2 valid ('+s.sources.length+' sources)');"
scripts.sources:sync: cd scrapling-agent && uv run python -c "import server; print(server.crawl_sources())"
